entities.name: Pieter Hendrik van Cittert
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pieter Hendrik van Cittert was a Dutch physicist and science historian. He is known for proving the van Cittert–Zernike theorem about the coherence of electromagnetic radiation in 1934. He also founded the University Museum in Utrecht.
